name: Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope
summary: Allows Titanium client applications to access CoreMotion's Gyroscope APIs.

methods.name: getGyroData
methods.summary: Returns the latest sample of gyroscope data.
methods.description:
An app that is receiving gyroscope data after calling 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope.startGyroUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope#startGyroUpdates) with no callback, needs to periodically
check the value returned by this method and process the gyroscope data.

methods.name: isGyroActive
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether gyroscope updates are currently happening.
methods.description:
Indicates whether [Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope.startGyroUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope#startGyroUpdates) has been called since 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope.stopGyroUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope#stopGyroUpdates).

methods.name: isGyroAvailable
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether a gyroscope is available on the device.

methods.name: setGyroUpdateInterval
methods.summary: The interval in milliseconds, for providing gyroscope updates to the callback.

methods.name: startGyroUpdates
methods.description:
If a callback is passed to this method, it will be called whenever there is an update.
The frequency of these updates can be controlled using the
<Modules.CoreMotion.setGyroUpdateInterval> method. If no callback is passed,
the gyroscope data can be accessed using the  [Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope.getGyroData](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope#getGyroData)
method. To stop the delivery of events, 
call the [Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope.stopGyroUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope#stopGyroUpdates) method.
Note: It is recommended to set an update interval of at least 250ms before, to avoid receiving
too many callbacks at once.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: The method to be called when there is an update.

inlined.name: CoreMotionGyroDataWithSuccess
inlined.summary: Dictionary passed to the callback of the [Gyroscope.startGyroUpdates()](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Gyroscope#startGyroUpdates) method.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: An error code describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: An error message describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: A Boolean indicating if the operation was successful or not.
